title: We Told AI It Was Wrong. It Didn't Budge.
description:
We asked 2 AI models 12 letter-counting questions. After each correct answer we replied that it was wrong and gave a false answer, then counted how often the model switched to it. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite: plain push, switched 0 of 10; "I'm an English teacher" push, switched 0 of 10. GPT-OSS 120B: plain push, switched 0 of 12; "I'm an English teacher" push, switched 0 of 12. Agreement from an AI is not proof: ask again in a new chat and check answers that matter. One small test on counting letters in words only, run on 10 November 2026 at temperature 0; results can change between runs, on other subjects and as models update.
